description: Source code for a multi-threaded proxy resolver implementation in Chromium, including classes for managing worker threads, jobs, and proxy resolution requests.

classes.name: Executor
classes.description: Manages a worker thread and a synchronous proxy resolver for handling proxy resolution jobs.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous proxy resolver that manages multiple executor threads for handling requests.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Base class for jobs executed on worker threads, including proxy resolution requests and resolver creation.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::RequestImpl
classes.description: Represents a proxy resolution request associated with a job.

classes.name: CreateResolverJob
classes.description: Job that runs on a worker thread to create a proxy resolver.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::GetProxyForURLJob
classes.description: Job that runs on a worker thread to perform proxy resolution for a URL.

methods.name: Executor::StartJob
methods.description: Submits a job to be run on the executor's thread.

methods.name: Executor::OnJobCompleted
methods.description: Called when a job has finished execution.

methods.name: Executor::Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the executor, cancels jobs, and joins the thread.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Initiates a proxy resolution request for a URL.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::AddNewExecutor
methods.description: Creates and starts a new worker thread for proxy resolution.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::OnExecutorReady
methods.description: Handles the event when an executor becomes available to run a new job.
